# Lazy device statics with no re-arm hook, each with the reason it is safe.
# Generated by hand; tools/check_static_reset.py fails on an unlisted TU and on a
# stale entry (the TU now re-arms, or holds no lazy device static).
#
# Format: <path><two spaces><reason>
#
# Per-name entries (the TU re-arms, this static is not in its hook and not behind
# its generation check). A static that another TU resets names the function, which
# the gate requires to be defined under src/ outside the TU:
#   <path>::<name><two spaces>reset-by=<function><two spaces><reason>
#   <path>::<name><two spaces><reason>

src/compute/mmq_q8_imma_scratch.cu::g_imma_weights  reset-by=mmq_q8_imma_release_all  src/compute/mmq_q8_imma.cu frees every plane and clears the map; its registered hook mmq_q8_imma_reset_static_cuda_state calls it
src/compute/mmq_q8_imma_scratch.cu::g_last_quant  reset-by=mmq_q8_imma_release_all  it calls imma_act_forget(); the memo also compares g_imma_act.gen before it is trusted
src/runtime/engine_scheduler.cpp::g_ot  host timing sums (diagnostics.step_timing), holds no device resource
src/runtime/engine_scheduler.cpp::g_step_timing  host timing sums (diagnostics.step_timing), holds no device resource

# Log-once rule (C-12/D-10): a process-static flag named *logged*/*warned*/*once*/*said*/*noted*/*reported*.
#   <path>::<name><two spaces>log-once: <reason>
src/compute/gdn_scan_chunkpar.cu::attr_once  log-once: not a log latch, sets the kernel smem attribute once per process
src/compute/gdn_scan_chunkpar_pass.cu::attr_once  log-once: not a log latch, sets the kernel smem attribute once per process
src/model/hf_fetch.cpp::once  log-once: not a log latch, curl_global_init once per process
src/compute/json_constrain.cu::once  log-once: follow-up, as LogOnce its ERROR + return trips the log-and-return gate (B-108, list only shrinks)
